description: Returns sourced facts about Grand Theft Auto VI from the Sixfigs dataset that match a query: player warnings, cheats, map locations, money methods, vehicles and release status. Use this when the user asks a factual question about the game that the other Sixfigs tools do not cover, such as cheats, missable content, save rules or where a place is. Covers Grand Theft Auto VI only; returns no result rather than a guess when nothing matches. Facts are compiled from named sources after the game's 19 Nov 2026 release; each result shows its status (official, confirmed, single-source or disputed), sources and verified date. Pass max_chapter to include content up to the player's chapter.

max_chapter.description: Story chapter the player has reached. Content from later chapters is left out. Without it, major story spoilers are left out.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "cash limit" or "cheats trophies".
